proposed.explanation: Residential can coexist with commercial if uses are compatible and properly separated; mixed-use isn't inherently problematic. While ground-floor retail is common, nightclubs specifically create noise conflicts that make them inappropriate for residential adjacency. Modern acoustics help but cannot overcome the fundamental conflict; separation is more effective than treatment. Nightclub noise (105+ dB) is extreme; acoustic treatment alone cannot achieve adequate isolation for residential rest. Code typically requires separation or prohibition. incompatible uses must be separated; nightclub below residential violates program logic and is unacceptable even with treatment. Relocation to separate building or basement (isolated from residential) is proper solution.
